# Chuck Blake > Chuck Blake is a Brooklyn-based startup founder and fractional CTO who builds AI systems and developer tools. He created GetMusic.fm, builds Glance (glnc.io) and Recall Bridge, writes the newsletter In General, and makes electronic music as Corvoco. Most recently he was CTO at LEA, building document-intelligence systems for enterprise wealth management. This is the personal site of Chuck Blake (chuck.blake@gmail.com). It is server-rendered HTML built with Jekyll. ## Pages - [About](https://chuckblake.com/): Bio, what he's building now, and how to get in touch. - [Fractional CTO](https://chuckblake.com/fractional-cto/): Consulting on AI integration, technical architecture, and startup operations. - [Writing & talks](https://chuckblake.com/publications/): Posts and presentations on AI systems, developer relations, and productivity. - [Blog](https://chuckblake.com/blog/): Articles and notes. - [Projects](https://chuckblake.com/projects/): Things he's built. - [Music](https://chuckblake.com/music/): Electronic music made as Corvoco, and a listening log. ## Profiles (same person) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chuckblake/) - [X](https://x.com/chuckblake) - [GitHub](https://github.com/chuckblake) - [In General — newsletter](https://ingeneral.substack.com/) - [Corvoco — Bandcamp](https://corvoco.bandcamp.com) - [Crunchbase](https://www.crunchbase.com/person/chuck-blake) ## Projects - [GetMusic](https://getmusic.fm): Tools that help independent artists promote their music on Bandcamp. - [Glance](https://glnc.io): Expectation monitoring for automated work — scheduled checks, output expectations, alerts, and remediation work items for humans or AI agents. - [Recall Bridge](https://recallbridge.ai): A hosted AI memory layer giving every AI tool access to one persistent, organized brain.
